invariants: rc.1 removes @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-sqlite. Canonical profiles use JSONL; the retired upstream Loader name is unavailable.
An explicitly mounted product-owned @deepseek-ai/dsh-win7-session-sqlite-reader exposes legacySessionReader, never sessionPersistence. Its actual manifest participates in active package inventory.
The reader opens existing schema-19 databases with SQLite read-only flags, validates the historical application/schema identity, refuses SQL writes and preserves source database bytes.

Exports preserve logical isSeeded and exact inheritedEventCount, refuse duplicate target identities, and produce canonical none/zstd JSONL. Cold preparation and subsequent writes continue through the rc.1 JSONL provider.

Actual archived alpha.1 Source databases retain their historical Source identity. New native and extracted-reader observations qualify compatibility with those files, not rc.1 upstream-provider parity.

Context disposal drains borrowed preparations and closes native handles; exported data remains usable after reader disposal. Three preset Remote model/fork/search/cold-restart consumers verify compatibility.
identity: Historical schema19/application identity; rc.1 logical Session identity isSeeded plus explicit inheritedEventCount.
ownership: Product-owned optional reader; reversible service registration and native handle disposal; canonical JSONL owns all new writes.
ordering: Read and validate before export; reserve target identity before creating a new log; reject overwrite; keep original database unchanged.
errors: Missing, foreign, unsupported and corrupt historical databases fail closed. Export collisions reject without replacing the target.
cancellation: Read observers use existing signal-aware detached storage reads; disposal drains preparations.
adaptation: Explicit alpha.1 data compatibility with pinned private SQLite/Zstandard runtimes. The retired package is not reintroduced under an upstream alias.
open_questions: Real Windows 7 machine validation remains deferred; current bounded qualification is recorded in rc1_review.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
